preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The integer n is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive, for each test case.
The integer k is between 0 and n, inclusive, for each test case.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output is a permutation of 1, 2, ..., n)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a permutation of the numbers 1 through n such that the number of indices i for which A_i = i is exactly k.
